title: Sort'em All
description: A lightweight QoL mod that adds fast, intuitive inventory sorting and item management.
body:
Simple, fast, and intuitive inventory sorting for a smoother Minecraft experience.

This mod adds quality-of-life improvements to inventory management, making it easier and faster to organize your items without interrupting gameplay.

✨ Features
⚡ Quick inventory sorting with a customizable keybind****
📦 Smart item organization based on item types
🔍 Item highlighting to easily find matching items
🎯 Clean and minimal UI designed for clarity and speed
⚙️ Configurable settings to fit your playstyle
🛡️ Multiplayer Compatibility
Server-friendly design
Automation features are disabled or restricted in multiplayer
No unfair advantages or hidden mechanics
🧪 Project Status

This mod is actively being developed and improved.
More advanced features (like intelligent chest sorting) are planned for future versions.

💡 Goal

To provide a lightweight, clean, and useful inventory management system that feels natural and enhances the vanilla experience.
